window_text.15: Once again there was a battle between the Philistines and Israel. David went down with his men to fight against the Philistines, and he became exhausted.
window_text.16: And Ishbi-Benob, one of the descendants of Rapha, whose bronze spearhead weighed three hundred shekels and who was armed with a new sword, said he would kill David.
window_text.17: But Abishai son of Zeruiah came to David’s rescue; he struck the Philistine down and killed him. Then David’s men swore to him, saying, “Never again will you go out with us to battle, so that the lamp of Israel will not be extinguished.”

window_text.19: In another battle with the Philistines at Gob, Elhanan son of Jair the Bethlehemite killed the brother of Goliath the Gittite, who had a spear with a shaft like a weaver’s rod.

items.question: Who are defeated by David and his men?
items.answer: The four descendants of Rapha in Gath

window_text.20: In still another battle, which took place at Gath, there was a huge man with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot—twenty-four in all. He also was descended from Rapha.
window_text.21: When he taunted Israel, Jonathan son of Shimeah, David’s brother, killed him.
window_text.22: These four were descendants of Rapha in Gath, and they fell at the hands of David and his men.
